caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object resembling a decorative horse bit against a plain, off-white background. The object has two main vertical arms; the left arm is colored with alternating black and white stripes, while the right arm features a dark brown, rust-like color. Each arm ends at the top in a circular ring. On the left side just below the ring, there is a silver-gray spherical element with engraved leaf or feather-like patterns extending behind it. The central part links the two arms, containing a cylindrical gold and brown component between the arms. Below, near the end of each vertical arm, there are smaller silver spheres, and attached to the very bottom are dark brown segments that appear to be leather straps or tassels. The name "HARRY MAIN WADDELL" is printed in small capital letters in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Bit
